data.name: Sheba
data.gender_notes: Sheba is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Sheba is recorded in name-lists as “Seven or oath”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sheba expresses “Seven or oath”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sheba total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_hebrew.name: שְׁבָא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root shav, meaning to pour or anoint.

in_greek.name: Σηβα
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Sheba, meaning oil. The name was also used to refer to the Sabaeans, a people from southern Arabia known for their wealth in oil.

in_latin.name: Seba
in_latin.long_meaning: Latin form of the Greek name Sabaean, derived from the Hebrew name Sheba, meaning oil.

biblical_reference.note: Refers to the queen of Sheba, a famous queen of Ethiopia who visited King Solomon in Jerusalem.
